name: caveman
description: 🪨 why use many token when few token do trick. Viral skill + proxy for coding agents that cuts 65% of tokens by talking like a caveman.
one_liner: A joke-flavored tool that rewrites your AI coding assistant's conversations into terse 'caveman' language, acting as a proxy that claims to cut token usage — and therefore cost — by 65%.
buyer: A startup CTO paying a large monthly bill for AI coding assistant usage across their engineering team who wants to cut costs without switching tools.
business_use_cases: An agency running AI coding agents across dozens of client repos installs it as a proxy to shave real dollars off its monthly token bill.
A bootcamp uses it to teach students about token economics and prompt compression in a memorable, funny way.
A solo indie hacker running long overnight agent loops uses it to stretch a limited API budget further.

money_ideas.idea: Turn the underlying compression technique into a broader 'token optimization proxy' SaaS for any LLM API, taking a cut of the measured savings.

steal_this: Fork the compression approach into a drop-in proxy for whichever AI coding tool you use, measure your own real token savings this weekend, and publish the numbers as marketing.
